This land battle item can be purchased for 300 ducats in the following cities:

Eastern Europe: Rome (one of the two Coliseum item shop NPCs)
Western Africa: Abidjan, Saint-Georges, Sao Tome, Douala, Benin, Luanda
South Africa: Benguela
